# Atria.Eponym

> Atria.Eponym is an independent developer based in France. Simple, polished apps for Android, iPhone, Mac and PC: no ads, no mandatory account, as little data as possible. Apps are translated into 28 languages.

Contact: atria.eponym@gmail.com. Showcase in 28 languages: https://atriaeponym.com/ (English), https://atriaeponym.com/fr/ (French).

## Apps

### MyLilBudget (French: MonPtitBudget)
- Pocket money and budget for teens, alone or with family. No ads, no account.
- FR : Argent de poche et budget des ados, seul ou en famille. Sans pub, sans compte.
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atriaeponym.familypocket
- App Store (iPhone): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6822458545
- Microsoft Store (Windows): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9PMVV9S1H489
- Page: https://atriaeponym.com/familypocket/

### Speed GPS
- GPS speedometer, sky map and trips, and much more. Offline, no ads.
- FR : Compteur de vitesse GPS, carte du ciel et trajets, et bien plus encore. Hors ligne, sans pub.
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atriaeponym.speedgps
- App Store (iPhone): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6823107885
- Page: https://atriaeponym.com/speedgps/

### Mac Live · Computer Live
- Your Mac live on your phone: temperatures, processor, battery and alerts, even with the app closed.
- FR : Votre Mac en direct sur votre téléphone : températures, processeur, batterie et alertes, même app fermée.
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atriaeponym.maclive
- Page: https://atriaeponym.com/maclive/

### Brevet DNB Ortho & Grammaire
- All the spelling the French brevet dictation tests: every trap found in past papers since 2011 and every point of the year-9 curriculum, in dictations read aloud, corrected and marked as on exam day. No ads, no account.
- FR : Toute l'orthographe que la dictée du brevet évalue : les pièges relevés dans les annales depuis 2011 et les notions du programme de 3ᵉ, en dictées lues à voix haute, corrigées et notées comme à l'examen. Sans pub, sans compte.
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atriaeponym.dicteednb
- App Store (iPhone): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6824308790
- App Store (Mac): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6824308790
- Microsoft Store (Windows): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9N30XKR26HKB
- Page: https://atriaeponym.com/dicteednb/

### Perfume Price Tracker
- Compare your perfume prices across shops, delivery included, and get an alert when they drop. No ads, no account.
- FR : Comparez le prix de vos parfums entre boutiques, livraison comprise, et recevez une alerte quand il baisse. Sans pub, sans compte.
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atriaeponym.parfumpocket
- App Store (iPhone): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6824535728
- Page: https://atriaeponym.com/parfumpocket/

### Stock Cockpit
- Stock prices for Paris, Europe, the US and London, 15-min delayed. Free, no ads, no account.
- FR : Cours de bourse Paris, Europe, US, Londres, différés 15 min. Gratuit, sans pub, sans compte.
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atriaeponym.stockcockpit
- Microsoft Store (Windows): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9MSVWVC0L4J5
- Page: https://atriaeponym.com/stockcockpit/

### SoundCatch
- Audio recorder: record the sound of an app or open a file, cut out what you do not need, export one clean file. No ads, no account.
- FR : Enregistreur audio : enregistre le son d'une appli ou ouvre un fichier, coupe les passages inutiles, exporte un fichier propre. Sans pub, sans compte.
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atriaeponym.soundcatch
- Page: https://atriaeponym.com/soundcatch/

### Diapo
- Your photos, big, from a folder or a whole disk. They are never modified.
- FR : Vos photos en grand, d'un dossier ou d'un disque entier. Elles ne sont jamais modifiées.
- Microsoft Store (Windows): https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9P6MPV8Q9ZP1
- Google Play (Android): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.atriaeponym.diapo
- Page: https://atriaeponym.com/diapo/
